title: Pipecat Smart Turn v3.2 — semantic end-of-turn detector (standalone ONNX)
notes: Verified live 2026-11-09 (repo README + Daily.co announcement). BSD-2-Clause code AND weights. Relevance: Jerry SPEC-VOICE semantic EOT layer, runs standalone via raw ORT during Silero silence.

sections.heading: Verified facts
sections.body: BSD-2 code+weights; 8MB int8 CPU / 32MB fp32 GPU; ~8M params; 23 langs; 10-12ms modern CPU / ~60ms cheap vCPU / 3.3ms L40S; 16kHz mono <=8s context; runs only during Silero silence; standalone raw-ORT usage supported.

sections.heading: Official >8s policy
sections.body: Truncate from the beginning, keep the last ~8s, zero-pad at beginning; re-run on the entire turn recording when new speech arrives. Semantic quality on long monologues then depends on the tail window only.
